rationale: FX02 says the fair_value XBRL unit is not USD, but the flagged value is UNIT_USD. The raw schedule of investments uses dollar signs for Cost and Fair Value columns, and representative flagged rows such as Assured Partners show the Fair Value amount under a $ column. The source supports USD-denominated fair values; the check is misclassifying the UNIT_USD token as non-USD.
